title: Plan: Q4_K CPU dot microprobe for 4Expert plus source/page combined bound
purpose: Close or reopen the only plausible combination left by the external refresh: top_k=4 Q4_K routed experts plus source/page elimination plus a faster CPU fallback kernel.

hypothesis.positive_case: 4Expert reduces active experts from 6 to 4, but Q4_K expert role bytes are 4.5 MiB versus native MXFP4 4.25 MiB. The active source ratio is therefore 0.705882. If Q4_K x Q8_K CPU dot throughput is high enough and source/page stalls can also be eliminated, the combined route might exceed 10 tok/s.
hypothesis.negative_case: If Q4_K CPU dot throughput is below the combined threshold, then 4Expert/Q4_K cannot reopen the route even before accounting for routing tensor compatibility, Q4_K stream/cache implementation, full-model download, TTFT, and correctness risk.

microprobe.metric: q4_src_gib_s; compare against 63.983 GiB/s zero-overhead and 91.978 GiB/s with 500ms integration overhead

accept_reject_rules.reopen_condition: Only if both DS4-like shapes exceed 91.978 GiB/s with enough margin should a source plan be considered. A value between 63.983 and 91.978 is still not source-ready because routing/Q4_K stream/full-model/TTFT/correctness integration overhead has no budget.
accept_reject_rules.reject_condition: Reject the combined 4Expert+Q4_K+source-page route if either shape is below 63.983 GiB/s or if margin over 91.978 GiB/s is absent.
accept_reject_rules.no_sota_claim: This standalone microprobe is not a model run and cannot be promoted as SOTA. Any later SOTA still requires strict-cold vendor France correctness, 16GB cgroup including page cache, TTFT gate, and clean pushed-source reproduction.
